name: Aurelia
description: Aurelia is an angel and the guildmaster, or warleader, of the Boros Legion on Ravnica.

summary.text: Aurelia is an angel and the guildmaster, or warleader, of the Boros Legion on Ravnica.

bio.text: Boros soldiers and a goblin worker say that Aurelia will replace the disgraced angel Vinrenn as master of the guild, and she is cast as seeking to replace and banish him.

citations.text: "Krenko, Mob Boss" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2012.

bio.text: As guildmaster she is among the guild representatives gathered for the plan to resurrect the Firemind as the new Living Guildpact, in a ritual led by Nissa.

timeline.summary: In the mess hall Krenko overhears Boros soldiers saying the guild's succession has come down to a duel, found by the Azorius in the fine print.
timeline.quote: "No, the nosy Azorius found it in the fine print," he said.

citation.work: Krenko, Mob Boss
citation.text: "Krenko, Mob Boss" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2012.

timeline.summary: A goblin worker tells Krenko that Aurelia will replace the disgraced angel Vinrenn as master, who will be banished.
timeline.quote: Aurelia's gonna be our new master, 'cause she says that no disgraced angel's got the right to rule.

citation.work: Krenko, Mob Boss
citation.text: "Krenko, Mob Boss" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2012.

timeline.summary: The statues reveal that Vraska's words have been broadcast to the guild leaders gathered at Sunhome.
timeline.quote: Your statements have been broadcast to all those who've attended.

timeline.summary: The guild representatives arrive; Lazav reveals he was disguised as Varryvort.

timeline.summary: Zarek reveals the plan is to resurrect the Firemind as the new Living Guildpact, surprising several guild leaders.
timeline.quote: We are here to resurrect the Firemind as the new Living Guildpact.

timeline.summary: Hekara admits she came without Rakdos's permission, and the leaders doubt the plan without him.
timeline.quote: The Boss didn't send me in his place. I totally came without his permission.

timeline.summary: Nissa leads the ritual; leylines light under the ten guild representatives and they fall into a trance with golden light pouring from their eyes.
timeline.quote: Suddenly, golden light poured out of twenty-one sightless eyes.

timeline.summary: Boros airships and sky forces arrive and Gideon rides a pegasus toward Bolas.
timeline.quote: He was wielding the sword that could bring an end to all this—by bringing an end to Nicol Bolas.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Chandra wrap Gideon's armor in leaves and the Gatewatch leads a solemn procession.

timeline.summary: The guilds assign Zarek to hunt Tezzeret, Vraska to hunt Dovin Baan, and hire Kaya to assassinate Liliana.
